title: Novia a la Fuga, Bebé a bordo
description: Después de ser drogado, Eason, un poderoso CEO, pasa la noche con Chloe, inconsciente de su identidad. Al negarse a revelar la identidad del padre, Chloe agranda la brecha entre ellos. Pero la situación se vuelve aún más oscura cuando Maura, decidida a mantener a Chloe alejada de Eason, mata a la madre de Chloe y la amenaza para que se mantenga alejada.

title: A Mãe Traída é a Herdeira Divina
description: Lena é a herdeira do poder divino de Atena. Uma figura materna acolhedora e movida pela compaixão, mas que, por trás da doçura, esconde uma presença firme e imponente. Ela foi a Suprema Estrategista da lendária Ordem de Aegis, mas abandonou o poder após um incêndio devastador, há vinte e cinco anos. Naquele dia, ela arriscou a vida para salvar sete crianças e as criou como seus próprios filhos. Por décadas, Lena manteve sua identidade em segredo. Mas, no dia do seu aniversário de cinquenta anos, os sete filhos pelos quais ela sacrificou tudo são manipulados por suas famílias biológicas e se voltam contra ela, acusando-a de sequestro. Traída e de coração partido, Lena desperta o poder que estava adormecido havia tanto tempo. Não mais disposta a sofrer em silêncio, ela quer retomar o poder, revelar a verdade e lembrar ao mundo e a seus filhos por que um dia foi temida como a líder destinada a comandar.

description: A squad of future soldiers is abandoned on a planet and madness sets in.

title: S.O.B.
description: A successful movie director makes the most expensive film in his career and it becomes a huge flop. He tries to salvage his career by reshooting the film as an erotic production, where its family-friendly star takes her top off.

title: Horizonte B
description: Two brothers take their late father's car for a strange road trip: Matheus, the older, needs to have a talk with an ex-girlfriend in another town, and Joao Pedro (JP), the younger, tags along in order to stop by a UFO convention in the way, in the hopes of uncovering the mystery surrounding an odd, glowing rock he's found in the woods.

title: Kian's Bizarre B&B [English] S1-S2
description: Kian84 manages an unconventional guesthouse, Kian Bizarre B&B, on Ulleungdo Island, providing a distinctive experience for young guests. The establishment combines elements of healing and humor, presented through Kian84's distinctive lens.

title: B-Side
description: When an underground radio DJ makes fun of a fading pop star who happens to listen to his show, the two begin an unlikely relationship. But difficult life and career crossroads jeopardize their idyllic New York romance.

title: Plan B
description: In order to compete with corporate bars and chain restaurants, a local tavern owner changes his sports bar into a strip bar.

title: King B.'s ROOST
description: Chicago Mafia Hit Man Alex Sims finds himself on the wrong end of the gun in this story about a hit man that gets hit by his own organization.

title: 19B
description: in an abandoned villa in a once-refined neighborhood, an old guard has been living since the 1960s. when suddenly, this world is turned upside down by an overzealous young man forcing him to face his fears, his past.

title: R&B Divas
description: Each has had their ups and each have had their downs -- all in the harsh light of stardom. Faith Evans, Nicci Gilbert, Monifah Carter, Syleena Johnson and KeKe Wyatt -- five strong women who have been broken down and are rebuilding from the ground up. R&B Divas takes you inside the lives of these music stars as they work, play and struggle to get their lives and careers back on track. Brought together by their friendship and love of R&B goddess Whitney Houston, these incredible singers are dealing with everything from divorce to drugs and sexuality.

title: C
description: The Japanese government was rescued from the brink of financial collapse by the Sovereign Wealth Fund.

title: Wife in Apt C
description: When sports photographer Paul is temporarily confined to a wheelchair after a collision on the field with a linebacker, he thinks he will go crazy from boredom - until he catches a glimpse of the wife living in Apartment C across the way. With a parade of men coming in and out of her bedroom, and her shades wide open, Paul has a non-stop sex show right outside his window.

title: Fangs of Fortune
description: A powerful demon, tired of existence, embarks on a journey of rejuvenation instead of death. Chance encounters bring together a group of youths tracing a bloody path through the world.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: C/O Sir
description: Jayabrata Ray, a teacher of a reputed school in Kurseong, finds himself in a helpless situation after losing his eyesight. Although the school authorities allow him to continue with his job for a while, but all hell breaks loose when he starts getting threat calls from the management asking him to vacate his property that is situated right inside the school premises. Jayabrata, who had also been a student of the same school, could see through their real intention and simply refuses to budge.

title: The First Jasmine
description: Li Ye marries Xiuyao Mo while her sister Ying Ye weds Li Ye's childhood friend Jingli Mo. Sealed on Mount Li for eight years, Li Ye secretly avenges officials who harmed her home. She and Xiuyao unite to help emperor defeat conspiracies.

title: Sweet Teeth [Hindi]
description: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

title: World War C
description: It's war. War against an invisible enemy that is not as deadly as we are told. The world is changing rapidly. Disproportionate measures are taken worldwide that disrupt society as a whole. A dichotomy in society forced vaccinations and restrictions on freedom. Have we had the worst? Or is there something more disturbing to awaiting us.

title: A, B, C... Manhattan
description: Three women are to make vital decisions about their future. Colleen wants to be a photographer but can't support her daughter Stella. Kacey is looking both for her dog stolen by her ex-boyfriend and for her girlfriend who's dumped her. Kate decided to break up with Stevie and start living on her own.

title: Housing Complex C [English]
description: Follows Kimi, as trouble seems to follow her wherever she goes, and now horrific incidents begin to happen in the small housing complex where she lives - is an ancient evil stalking the residents of Housing Complex C?

title: Create Option C: My Journey with Cancer
description: An actress on the peak of her career, Lourdes Colon, was securing guest star roles on hit television series and movies. Always having felt that she was meant to do something greater, make an impact on the world somehow, the rising actress believed that her way of doing so was through the media. As she continued to feel that her purpose had yet to be accomplished she asked the universe through prayer and meditation for the answer and the answer came the day that she was diagnosed with Hodgkin's Lymphoma.

title: Guess Who I Am [Hindi]
description: Song Yao who never misses a beat in punishing scumbags encounters the fake prince of Chengtian Group. Caught in a Smiths-like battle, the "unremarkable" girl with electrifying eyes and the liar "CEO" begin their story. Legend has it that there's such a person who makes rich scumbags quake in their boots because she never fails to make them suffer the consequences of their actions. This girl's name is Song Yao (Zhang Yuxi). It's all thanks to her fantastic assets in attracting the rich. Any person who is worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her inextricably as long as he looks into her eyes. Yet no matter how powerful she is, there is a day when she will encounter her Waterloo. Song Yao's eyes fail to work on "Ji Chengchuan" who is the prince of Chengtian Group. Little does she know that this is entirely because the prince in front of him is an impostor named Qin Hao (Wang Ziqi). The meeting of the two "actors" is destined to be explosive.
